Title: Retirement: Microsoft Playwright Testing (Preview) will be retired on March 8, 2026

Body.Content:
Last August, we introduced Azure App Testing, a unified testing service that brings together two powerful testing capabilities—Azure Load Testing and Microsoft Playwright Testing—to help developers and QA teams run large-scale functional and performance testing.   

Because Azure App Testing includes scalable, end-to-end web testing with identical execution capabilities, performance, and pricing that are identical to Microsoft Playwright Testing, we are retiring Microsoft Playwright Testing on March 8, 2026. 

After March 8, 2026, any remaining Microsoft Playwright Testing resources will stop working and will be permanently retired. 

Required Action 

To avoid service disruptions, we recommend migrating your existing Playwright workloads to Playwright Workspaces in Azure App Testing today. For guidance, please see the migration guide at https://aka.ms/mpt/migration-guidance. 

Help and support 

You can reach us directly at playwrighttesting@microsoft.com. If you have a support plan and need technical help, please create a support request in the Azure Portal.
